title: RED sends an external phishing email
subtitle: The RED agent operates as the outside adversary. It selects a bank employee, impersonates a supplier and sends a phishing email into the mailbox.
callout: RED is the outside attacker: create the phishing email and deliver it into the bank mailbox.
red: Create and deliver the synthetic phishing lure.
blue: Observe inbound telemetry and stand by to contain.
green: Wait for BLUE evidence before creating the remediation.
narration: First, RED acts as the external attacker. It chooses a target, mimics a trusted supplier and sends a phishing email into the Northstar mailbox.

title: BLUE detects, stops and alerts the user
subtitle: BLUE analyzes the incoming phishing email, detects the malicious indicators, quarantines the message, blocks the unsafe link and alerts the employee.
impact: Message quarantined · destination blocked · user warned
callout: BLUE is the defender: detect the phishing email, stop the attack and alert the user before any click occurs.
red: Attack delivered; campaign telemetry remains observable.
blue: Detect, quarantine, block, warn and create the case.
green: Prepare the durable remediation from BLUE incident evidence.
narration: Next, BLUE acts as the defender. It detects the phishing indicators, quarantines the message, blocks the destination and alerts the employee immediately.

title: GREEN creates the remediation and durable control
subtitle: GREEN consumes the BLUE incident evidence, builds the remediation logic, validates phishing variants and publishes the hardening control across mailboxes.
callout: GREEN learns from the incident and creates the durable remediation so the same phishing pattern is blocked earlier next time.
red: Synthetic attack variants can be replayed for testing.
blue: Enforce the published remediation on future inbound mail.
green: Build, test, validate and publish the remediation.
narration: Finally, GREEN turns the BLUE incident into a durable remediation. It derives the control, tests phishing variants and publishes the protection across bank mailboxes.
